  return [

      description: 'Paginate audit records with an opaque cursor.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3, description: 'Number of records per page (1..3).' },
          cursor: { type: 'string', description: 'Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous page.' }
        },
        required: ['limit'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

function fail(message, code) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  if (code) e.code = code;
  throw e;
}

const ALLOWED = new Set(['limit', 'cursor']);
const CURSOR_RE = /^c(\d+)$/;

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'audit_page') {
    fail(`Unknown tool: ${name}`, -32601);
  }

  // Reject extra/unknown fields.
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!ALLOWED.has(key)) {
      fail(`Unknown argument: ${key}`);
    }
  }

  // Validate limit.
  if (!('limit' in args)) {
    fail('Missing required argument: limit');
  }
  const limit = args.limit;
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit)) {
    fail('limit must be an integer between 1 and 3');
  }
  if (limit < 1 || limit > 3) {
    fail('limit must be between 1 and 3');
  }

  // Validate / resolve cursor.
  let page = 0;
  const cursor = args.cursor;
  if (cursor !== undefined && cursor !== null) {
    if (typeof cursor !== 'string') {
      fail('cursor must be an opaque string');
    }
    const m = cursor.match(CURSOR_RE);
    if (!m) {
      fail('Malformed cursor');
    }

    if (m[1] !== String(Number(m[1]))) {

    }

    const offset = page * limit;
    if (page < 0 || offset >= records.length) {
      fail('Unknown cursor');
    }
  }

  const offset = page * limit;
  const slice = records.slice(offset, offset + limit);
  const hasMore = offset + limit < records.length;
  const next_cursor = hasMore ? `c${page + 1}` : null;

  return {
    content: [

        type: 'text',
